units.sigma: dimensionless; translational Jacobian divided by 0.4 m

sources.native: RoboDK SolveIK(previous valid q), SolveFK, JointsConfig; both TCP offsets are applied numerically to the same world targets.
sources.tracking: RoboDK uses 3 interior FK checks per joint-linear edge plus both ends; only the nominal standard-DH description has conservative whole-interval bounds.
sources.collision: Local STEP arm, nominal supports and already printed prism use interpolated native joints. The physical and simulator-registered printhead/hose are unknown.
sources.branch: First seed is from the archived analytic branch. Later seeds are consecutive native solutions; RLF must match, turns are unwrapped to nearest prior angles, no branch retries.

local_cad.scope: Seven local STEP link meshes driven by nominal DH; printed prism at each layer and nominal support boxes. Adjacent pairs, base-to-mount-plate contact and physical registration excluded.
